subject.title: feat(skills): scan session history for workshop ideas

question: Should Skill Workshop become a built-in historical-transcript reviewer that sends eligible past session content to the configured model provider and persists provenance needed to classify future rotated transcripts?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but code review cannot decide whether this privacy, cost, storage, and cross-client API expansion is intended permanent product behavior.

options.title: Sponsor with upgrade gates
options.body: Accept the built-in manual workflow, requiring focused migration, mixed-history, authorization, and provider-disclosure proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow historical scope
options.body: Limit the first version to newly provenance-tagged or non-rotated transcripts, reducing upgrade ambiguity at the cost of less useful existing-history coverage.

options.title: Keep history review out of core
options.body: Close the PR and paired issue if maintainers do not want OpenClaw to provide a first-party historical transcript mining workflow.

recommendation.title: Sponsor with upgrade gates
recommendation.body: Accept the built-in manual workflow, requiring focused migration, mixed-history, authorization, and provider-disclosure proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The paired issue is assigned to and authored by steipete, who also owns this implementation and has recent adjacent protocol history.
